properties.description: Self-Hosted Integration Runtime for secure data movement between the on-premises SQL Server (source database with sample.bak) and Azure Data Factory. Must be installed on a machine within the on-premises network that has access to the source SQL Server.

installation_steps: 1. Download the Self-Hosted IR installer from the Azure portal (ADF > Manage > Integration Runtimes > IR-SelfHosted > Option 1: Express setup)
2. Install on a Windows machine within the on-premises network
3. Register using the authentication key from the Azure portal
4. Verify connectivity to the source SQL Server

system_requirements.network: Outbound HTTPS (443) to Azure Service Bus
